`harness.run_bytes` returns the CompletedProcess, not a tuple (run_request returns a tuple). Let me fix the call: `p = harness.run_bytes(raw.encode())` and `got = json.loads(p.stdout)`.

Also handle empty stdout.

src = open('difffuzz.py').read()
src = src.replace("""            got, p = harness.run_bytes(raw.encode())
            if p.returncode != 0:""",
"""            p = harness.run_bytes(raw.encode())
            try:
                got = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
            except Exception:
                got = None
            if p.returncode != 0 or got is None:""")
src = src.replace("""                print('RAW CRASH seed', seed, p.returncode, p.stderr[:300]); bad += 1; continue""",
"""                print('RAW CRASH seed', seed, p.returncode, p.stdout[:200], p.stderr[:300]); bad += 1; continue""")
open('difffuzz.py','w').write(src)
EOF
